items.q: So when he opens up the paper, it said --Jane Foreman-- the plane had fallen and killed 43 people in Portugal.

ctx.x: So nobody had read the paper. So when he opens up the paper, it said --Jane Foreman-- the plane had fallen and killed 43 people in Portugal. That was the last stop and they were
coming home and the pilot saved she and some -- Gypsy. But the other 43 drowned. He says, "That's our tour, you know." He says, "Looked like you'd say, 'Base, you was right one time.'"
